mapper.select:
SELECT SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo, SD.ProdName, SD.ProdQty, SD.ListPrice, SD.OrderProdName, SD.OrderItemName, SD.OrderProdQty, SD.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SD INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON SD.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode
WHERE ( SD.ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND SD.ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AND SD.ShopCode = '3018508386A1'

SELECT SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo, SD.OrderType, SD.ProdName, SD.ItemName, SD.Remark, SD.ProdQty, SD.ListPrice, SD.OrderProdName, SD.OrderItemName, SD.OrderProdQty, SD.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON SD.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode WHERE SD.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} ORDER BY SD.OrderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo, SD.ProdName
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SET ItemName = #{gift}, NVPrice = #{optionAmt}, Remark = '사은품 문자열 생성', ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = 1 AND IFNULL(OrderType, '') <> '사은품' AND ShopCode = #{shopCode}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SD.OrderNo FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirect SD WHERE SD.ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND SD.ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} ORDER BY SD.OrderNo
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderShoplinker S ON SD.OrderNo = S.ShopionOrderNo SET SD.ProdMemo01 = S.GoodAuctionno WHERE SD.ShipCheckDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND SD.ShipCheckDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND SD.ShopCode = #{shopCode} AND IFNULL(S.GoodAuctionno, '') <> '' AND CHAR_LENGTH(S.GoodAuctionno) <= 50
